ai_summary: ACME Solar Holdings' subsidiary has secured a significant 25-year Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with NTPC for a 150 MW hybrid solar, wind, and energy storage project at a tariff of Rs. 3.21 per unit, with the project expected to commence supply by June 2028. This domestic contract materially expands ACME Solar's PPA-locked under-construction portfolio to 5,080 MW, securing long-term revenue and solidifying its role in India's clean energy transition with dispatchable renewable solutions. No immediate red flags are apparent in this positive contract disclosure.
